Apply the shadshiny theme to a plotly chart

Source: R/chart-adapters.R
shad_theme_plotly.Rd

Experimental. Restyle a plotly plot with transparent backgrounds, tokenised fonts and gridlines, and the shadshiny categorical colorway. Requires plotly.

Usage

shad_theme_plotly(p, preset = NULL, dark = FALSE)

Arguments

p

A plotly object.

preset

A preset name or shad_current_theme() list.

dark

If TRUE, use dark-mode colors.

Value

The modified plotly object.

See also

Other shadshiny theming: shad_chart_colors(), shad_current_theme(), shad_theme(), shad_theme_echarts4r(), shad_theme_from_registry(), shad_theme_ggplot2(), shad_theme_scope(), shad_tokens()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p <- plotly::plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~wt, y = ~mpg,
                       type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
  p <- shad_theme_plotly(p, preset = "green", dark = TRUE)
}
